reference.text: Besides, it will not much signify what one wears this summer, after the ——shire have left Meryton, and they are going in a fortnight.”

reference.text: “They are going to be encamped near Brighton; and I do so want papa to take us all there for the summer!
Mamma would like to go, too, of all things!
